none: PAS WMID-6229C2: Roman coin, a silver denarius of Trajan
contea di ritrovamento: Worcestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver Roman denarius of the emperor Trajan (ruled 98-117 AD), dating from the period 98 to 111 AD. The coin is worn and incomplete so the exact type is uncertain. However what can be read of the obverse legend reads IMP CAES NERVA TRA... The reverse probably depicts Pax, but all that can be read of the legend is ...TR... The coin was minted in Rome. Reece period 5
